cohort: 500 mothers who delivered at RLJH & RC attached to SDUMC, Kolar, India between January 2011 and December 2011 and received postnatal counselling.
finding: Postnatal counselling was effective in increasing breastfeeding initiation and reducing top feeding in the first 3 days.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was noted as a significant reason mothers gave for not breastfeeding exclusively.
